deploy-checker: [preflight] 2026-03-21T10:02Z - HOLD: release promotion blocked. PROD secret 'SECRET_MODEL_KEY' format mismatch (expected base64 string, found JSON object). See /ops/deploy/preflight for details.

maria: saw the preflight, tagging @simon @alex. this will block the rollout if not fixed.

alex: on it. can you paste the actual values from staging and prod so I can diff?

maria: staging (ok): ```SECRET_MODEL_KEY=QWxhZGRpbjpvcGVuIHNlc2FtZQ==```
prod (bad): ```SECRET_MODEL_KEY={"sops":{"encrypted":"..."},"key":"ABCD1234"}```

jyoti: that looks like the entire sops JSON blob was put into the secret instead of the raw base64 key. likely migration/rotation script wrote the wrapped object.

simon: oncall here — we'll not promote while it's inconsistent. what's the failure mode?

alex: inference-worker tries to base64-decode SECRET_MODEL_KEY at startup, gets a JSON string -> crashloop. seen a few crash traces in canary logs earlier. recommend hold + backfill.

maria: canary had the new image but deploy-checker stopped prod promotion. good we caught it pre-promotion.

alex: proposed plan:
1) PAUSE promotion (hold is set)
2) Backfill PROD secret with raw base64 extracted from the sops file (from secrets repo or staging)
3) Run quick canary smoke then resume promotion
If backfill can't be completed in 20-30m, revert image tag to previous pinned image.

jyoti: conversion command i tested locally: ```sops -d secrets/model-secret.enc | jq -r .key | base64 --wrap=0```
That yields the raw base64 value to put into k8s secret.data.SECRET_MODEL_KEY.

kevin: infra note: we can't run sops -d in-cluster unless the runner has KMS access. i'll run conversion in our secure pipeline and push a short-lived secret patch.

simon: also need audit trail: who merged the rotation that replaced the secret? i see a merge yesterday.

maria: PR #5423 merged yesterday by @tia - tia can you confirm what your rotation wrote?

tia: yep, i ran the rotation job but accidentally wrote the encoded sops payload instead of the extracted key. i'll prepare a corrected backfill now and open INFRA-1298. apologies.

alex: ops steps for backfill (outline):
- generate raw value in secure pipeline: `sops -d secret.enc | jq -r .key | base64 --wrap=0`
- kubectl patch secret model-key -n prod --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/SECRET_MODEL_KEY","value":"<raw-b64>"}]'
- roll a single deployment pod to pick up new secret and run smoke

maria: decision: allow 20 minutes for backfill + smoke. if not healthy by then, rollback to previous image tag 2026.03.20-9f2a3b (revert PR #5419).

deploy-checker: [action] hold set by maria until 3141593473 (20m).

kevin: i'll run the conversion against a staging copy first and post results here. prepping pipeline job now.

jyoti: smoke criteria: 5 /v1/generate calls (concurrent) across canary & prod, expect <250ms and zero 5xx in 2m window.

simon: oncall will monitor logs and be ready to execute rollback PR if health degrades. i'll also prepare the rollback PR template (revert PR#5419, pin image tag).

maria: please add a short release-notes bullet: "Deployment held due to PROD secret format mismatch; backfill planned; expected unblock during morning change window."

tia: creating INFRA-1298 and adding assignees + security audit.

alex: after backfill: run quick canary then promote. @release-coordinator please schedule a follow-up if we need a new change window.

maria: agreed — canary then promote. thanks all :heart:

simon: updating incident/channel notes and monitoring dashboard. will post when backfill applied.
